```{r Cardiomyocyte subclustering}

CM <- subset(nuclei, idents = c("cardiomyocytes")) # from integrated dataset object subet cardiomyocytes

DefaultAssay(CM) <- "RNA"

CM[['integrated.rpca']] <- NULL
CM[['SCT']] <- NULL

CM[["RNA"]] <- split(CM[["RNA"]], f = CM$orig.ident)
Layers(CM[["RNA"]])

CM <- NormalizeData(CM, verbose = T)
CM <- FindVariableFeatures(CM, verbose = T)
CM <- ScaleData(CM, verbose = T)
CM <- RunPCA(CM, verbose = T)
gc()

CM <- IntegrateLayers(object = CM, method = RPCAIntegration, orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "integrated.rpca",  verbose = T) 

CM <- FindNeighbors(CM, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30)
CM <- FindClusters(CM, resolution = 0.5)
CM <- RunUMAP(CM, reduction = "integrated.rpca", dims = 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.rpca", return.model = T, verbose = T)

CM <- JoinLayers(CM)  

DimPlot(CM, reduction = "umap.rpca", group.by = "annot", split.by = "orig.ident")

saveRDS(CM, file = "ALL_Cardiomyocytes_integrated.RDS")

```

```{r check for doublet cluster contamination}

Idents(CM) <- "seurat_clusters" 

DotPlot(CM, features = c( "Ttn", "Ryr2", "Myh6", # CM markers
"Cdh5", "Pecam1", "Vwf", "Cyyr1", "Etl4", "Fabp4" , # Non-CM major cell type markers used to guide cluster exclusion due to possible doublet contamination
"Cytl1", "Tmem108", "Npr3", "Eng" ,
"Muc16", "Wdr17", "Sulf1", "Msln"  ,
"Col1a1", "Pcdh9", "Abca8a", "Bicc1" , 
"Trpc3", "Rgs5", "Nrxn1", "Abcc9", "Pdgfrb", "Notch3", "Pde8b" ,
"Csf1r", "Mrc1", "F13a1", "Slc9a9" ) , group.by = "seurat_clusters", assay = "RNA") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1)) + scale_color_viridis(direction = -1) + scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)

CM <- subset(CM, idents = c(9, 11, 15, 17, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26), invert = TRUE) # remove doublet satellite clusters 

```


```{r CM annotation}
CM <- FindClusters(CM, resolution = 0.25)
Idents(object = CM) <- "seurat_clusters"
CM_clust_markers_30perc <- FindAllMarkers(CM, min.pct = 0.3, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = T,  only.pos = T)
CM_clust_markers_10perc <- FindAllMarkers(CM, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = T,  only.pos = T)

    CM_clust_markers_30perc %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.01)%>%
    top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top5cl30
  
    CM_clust_markers_10perc %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.01)%>%
    top_n(n = 5, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top5cl10
    
Clustered_DotPlot(seurat_object = CM, features = top5cl30$gene) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
Clustered_DotPlot(seurat_object = CM, features = top5cl10$gene) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

#Markers of CM functional states used for annotation of subpopulations
# CM_1 (baseline ventricular CM marker expression) CM_1_high <- c("Ttn", "Ryr2", "Myh6")
# CM_2 (stress response) CM_2_high <- c( "Creb5", "Tlr4", "Ankrd1", "Xirp2", "Tgfb2", "Uck2", "Pvt1", "Fstl4", "Ankrd23", "Pdlim3", "Flnc")

# CM_4 (metabolic activity) CM_4_high <- c("Scgb1a1", "Myl7", "Cox5b", "Nppa", "Lrp1b",  "Chchd10", "Cox7a1", "Ndufa1", "Mb", "Eln", "Elob", "Ndufv3", "Atp5md", "Myl4", "Cox6c", "Uqcrb", "Atp5mpl", "Ndufc1", "Uqcr11",  "Atp5e", "Gapdh", "Ndufs6",  "Ndufa13",  "Ndufb11", "Ndufa3", "Tpt1", "Atp5g1", "Rpl12", "Atp5j", "Rpl23a", "Chchd2", "Atp5k", "Ndufa2", "Fth1", "Rpl4", "Uqcc2", "Atp5h", "Ndufa5", "Ndufb8", "Rps27", "S100a1", "Cox8b", "Cox6a2")

CM@meta.data$annot <- as.character(CM@meta.data$annot)
CM@meta.data$annot[CM@meta.data$annot == 0] <- "CM_1"  # e.g. seurat cluster 0 was assigned as CM_1 based on the cluster marker gene expression comparison


Idents(object = CM) <- "annot"
CM_annot_markers_30perc <- FindAllMarkers(CM, min.pct = 0.3,  logfc.threshold = 0.25, verbose = T,  only.pos = T)
    CM_annot_markers_30perc %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.01)%>%
    top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC) -> top20an30
Clustered_DotPlot(seurat_object = CM, features = top20an30$gene, colors_use_idents = Palette_CM3) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

FeaturePlot_scCustom(seurat_object = CM, features = c("Myh6", "Ttn", "Ryr2", "Nnt", "Kcnd2", "Smtn", "Tlr4", "Ankrd1", "Xirp2", "Slit2", "Knl1", "Esco2", "Mki67", "Top2a", "Neil3", "Mb","Ndufa1", "Cox5b"),  order = T, num_columns = 3, figure_plot = T, pt.size = 0.5)

CM_markers <- FindAllMarkers(CM, verbose = T)

CM1_cluster_markers <- CM_markers %>% 
  filter(cluster == "CM_1") %>%  
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) 

CM2_cluster_markers <- CM_markers %>% 
  filter(cluster == "CM_2") %>%  
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) 

CM3_cluster_markers <- CM_markers %>% 
  filter(cluster == "CM_3") %>%  
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) 

CM4_cluster_markers <- CM_markers %>% 
  filter(cluster == "CM_4") %>% 
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.01) %>% 
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0) 


Idents(CM) <- "annot"
CM@active.ident <- factor(CM@active.ident, 
                            levels=c("CM_4", "CM_3", "CM_2", "CM_1"))
avg_exp <- AverageExpression(CM, assays = "RNA",  return.seurat = FALSE)$RNA

genes_of_interest <- c("Myh6", "Ryr2", "Ttn", "Fhl2", "Creb5", "Grk5", "Dock4","Tlr4", "Xirp2", "Nppb", "Top2a", "Mki67", "Cenpp", "Kif11", "Pvt1", "Nop56", "Bzw2", "Gnl3", "Ezh2","Ccnd3", "Ndufa1", "Cox5b", "Cox6c", "Atp5", "Fabp3")
genes_of_interest <-  intersect(genes_of_interest, rownames(avg_exp))

plot_data <- avg_exp[genes_of_interest, ]
plot_data <- plot_data[rowSums(plot_data) > 0, ]
plot_data <- plot_data[, colSums(plot_data) > 0]
pheatmap(
  plot_data,
  scale = "row",                   
  cluster_rows = F,             
  cluster_cols =F,              
  display_numbers = FALSE,          
  color = colorRampPalette(c( "lightcyan", "white",  "darkmagenta"))(50),
  border_color = NA,
  fontsize_row = 12,                
  fontsize_col = 12,               
  main = "Average Gene Expression",
  cellwidth = 20,
  cellheight = 15
)
```

```{r CM Figures}
DotPlot_scCustom(seurat_object = CM, features = c("Ccnd3", "Bzw2","Gnl3", "Polr3g", "Ldha", "Dctd", "Smpdl3b", "Simc1", "Eno1", "Fasn", "Odc1", "Srm", "Taf4b", "Nop56"),  assay = "RNA", x_lab_rotate = T, flip_axes = F) + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))

# CM annotation bar plots split by dataset and genotype 
data_summary <- CM@meta.data %>%
  group_by(dataset, genotype, annot) %>%
  tally(name = "Count") %>%                   
  mutate(Frequency = Count / sum(Count))
print(head(data_summary))

data_summary$annot <- factor(data_summary$annot, 
                            levels= c("CM_1","CM_2","CM_3","CM_4"))
data_summary$dataset <- factor(data_summary$dataset, 
                            levels= c("juvenile","adult","MI"))


ggplot(data_summary, aes(x = dataset, y = Frequency, fill = annot)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +  
  facet_wrap(~ genotype) +                           
  labs(
    title = "CM subcluster percentage",
    x = "dataset genotype group",
    y = "% of cells"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c( "CM_1" = "#78DA46", "CM_2" = "#A9A7FF", "CM_3" ="#DD3721", "CM_4" = "#F3E54E")) + # Custom colors for phases
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.5, "lines")
  )
```

```{r GSEA ORA}
# Geneset enrichment over-representation analysis 
markers <- CM1_cluster_markers
markers <- CM_MI_degs_UP

top_genes <- markers %>%
  top_n(n = -500, wt = p_val_adj)

gene_entrez <- bitr(top_genes$X, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db)$ENTREZID

#1
msigdb_genes <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",  category = "H")
msigdb_list <- msigdb_genes %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)

#2
msigdb_genes <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",  category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")
msigdb_list <- msigdb_genes %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)

#3
msigdb_genes <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus",  category = "C2", subcategory = "REACTOME")
msigdb_list <- msigdb_genes %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)

enrich_results <- enricher(gene = gene_entrez,
                           TERM2GENE = msigdb_list,
                           pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05) 

enrichplot::dotplot(enrich_results, 
        showCategory = 10,            
        font.size = 9,              
        color = "p.adjust"           
        
) +   ggtitle(" ") + scale_fill_viridis(option="viridis") 

write.csv( enrich_results@result, "enrich_results_CM_XYZ.csv")

```

```{r GSEA dotplot custom plotting function}

library(grid)

parse_gene_ratio <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) return(x)

  x <- as.character(x)

  if (all(grepl("/", x[!is.na(x)]))) {
    nums <- strsplit(x, "/", fixed = TRUE)

    return(vapply(nums, function(z) {
      as.numeric(z[1]) / as.numeric(z[2])
    }, numeric(1)))
  }

  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}


set_fixed_panel_size <- function(
    p,
    panel_width = 7,
    panel_height = 7,
    left_axis_width = 7,
    unit = "cm"
) {
  gt <- ggplotGrob(p)

  panel_ids <- grep("^panel", gt$layout$name)

  panel_cols <- unique(gt$layout$l[panel_ids])
  panel_rows <- unique(gt$layout$t[panel_ids])

  gt$widths[panel_cols] <- grid::unit(panel_width, unit)
  gt$heights[panel_rows] <- grid::unit(panel_height, unit)

  axis_l_ids <- grep("^axis-l", gt$layout$name)

  if (length(axis_l_ids) > 0) {
    axis_l_cols <- unique(gt$layout$l[axis_l_ids])
    gt$widths[axis_l_cols] <- grid::unit(left_axis_width, unit)
  }

  gt
}


hard_wrap_label <- function(x, width = 25, replace_underscores = TRUE) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  if (replace_underscores) {
    x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  }

  x <- gsub("/", " / ", x)
  x <- gsub(":", ": ", x)
  x <- gsub("-", "- ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)

  vapply(x, function(label) {
    words <- unlist(strsplit(label, " ", fixed = TRUE))

    lines <- character()
    current <- ""

    for (w in words) {
      # If a single word is longer than width, split it forcibly
      if (nchar(w) > width) {
        chunks <- regmatches(w, gregexpr(paste0(".{1,", width, "}"), w))[[1]]

        if (nzchar(current)) {
          lines <- c(lines, current)
          current <- ""
        }

        lines <- c(lines, chunks)

      } else if (!nzchar(current)) {
        current <- w

      } else if (nchar(paste(current, w)) <= width) {
        current <- paste(current, w)

      } else {
        lines <- c(lines, current)
        current <- w
      }
    }

    if (nzchar(current)) {
      lines <- c(lines, current)
    }

    paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
  }, character(1))
}


plot_enrich_dotplot_fixed_panel <- function(
    enrich_df,
    top_n = 20,

    gene_ratio_col = "GeneRatio",
    description_col = "Description",
    count_col = "Count",
    p_col = "p.adjust",

    cluster_col = NULL,

    title = "Enrichment dotplot",

    label_width = 35,
    label_mode = c("truncate", "wrap", "none"),

    order_by = c("p", "gene_ratio", "count"),
    show_p_as = c("minus_log10", "raw"),

    dot_size_range = c(2.5, 8),

    p_cutoff = NULL,

    # Actual dotplot grid size
    panel_width_cm = 8,
    panel_height_cm = 8,

    # Fixed space reserved for wrapped pathway labels
    left_axis_width_cm = 8,

    # Final saved file size
    save_plot = FALSE,
    filename = "enrichment_dotplot_fixed_panel.pdf",
    device_width = 10,
    device_height = 8,

    # Viridis colour scale
    colour_scheme = "plasma",
    colour_direction = 1,
    y_label_size = 8,
    
    y_label_lineheight = 0.85,
    x_label_size = 10,
    legend_title_size = 9,
    legend_text_size = 8

) {
  label_mode <- match.arg(label_mode)
  order_by <- match.arg(order_by)
  show_p_as <- match.arg(show_p_as)

  if (!requireNamespace("viridis", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'viridis' is required. Install it with install.packages('viridis').")
  }

  required_cols <- c(gene_ratio_col, description_col, count_col, p_col)

  if (!is.null(cluster_col)) {
    required_cols <- c(required_cols, cluster_col)
  }

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(enrich_df))

  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required column(s): ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  df <- enrich_df %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(
      gene_ratio_numeric = parse_gene_ratio(.data[[gene_ratio_col]]),
      count_numeric = as.numeric(.data[[count_col]]),
      p_value_plot = as.numeric(.data[[p_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(
      is.finite(gene_ratio_numeric),
      is.finite(count_numeric),
      is.finite(p_value_plot)
    )

  if (!is.null(p_cutoff)) {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(p_value_plot <= p_cutoff)
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    stop("No enrichment terms left after filtering.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      p_value_safe = ifelse(p_value_plot == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_value_plot),
      minus_log10_p = -log10(p_value_safe)
    )

  if (is.null(cluster_col)) {
    df <- df %>%
      {
        if (order_by == "p") arrange(., p_value_plot)
        else if (order_by == "gene_ratio") arrange(., desc(gene_ratio_numeric))
        else arrange(., desc(count_numeric))
      } %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n)
  } else {
    df <- df %>%
      group_by(.data[[cluster_col]]) %>%
      {
        if (order_by == "p") arrange(., p_value_plot, .by_group = TRUE)
        else if (order_by == "gene_ratio") arrange(., desc(gene_ratio_numeric), .by_group = TRUE)
        else arrange(., desc(count_numeric), .by_group = TRUE)
      } %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

 
  df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    description_original = as.character(.data[[description_col]])
  ) %>%
  arrange(gene_ratio_numeric) %>%
  mutate(
    term_id = paste0("term_", seq_len(n())),
    term_id = factor(term_id, levels = term_id)
  )

label_lookup <- setNames(df$description_original, df$term_id)

label_function <- function(x) {
  labs <- unname(label_lookup[as.character(x)])

  if (label_mode == "truncate") {
    stringr::str_trunc(labs, width = label_width)
  } else if (label_mode == "wrap") {
    hard_wrap_label(
      labs,
      width = label_width,
      replace_underscores = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    labs
  }
}

  colour_var <- if (show_p_as == "minus_log10") {
    "minus_log10_p"
  } else {
    "p_value_plot"
  }

  colour_label <- if (show_p_as == "minus_log10") {
    paste0("-log10(", p_col, ")")
  } else {
    p_col
  }

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      x = gene_ratio_numeric,
      y = term_id,
      size = count_numeric,
      colour = .data[[colour_var]]
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = label_function) +
    scale_size_continuous(
    name = "Gene count",
    range = dot_size_range,
    guide = guide_legend(
    order = 2,
    direction = "vertical",
    title.position = "top",
    label.position = "right",
    ncol = 1,
    byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(colour = "grey30")
    )
  ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Gene ratio",
      y = NULL,
      colour = colour_label
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
     panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey85"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, colour = "grey90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

     axis.text.y = element_text(
       size = y_label_size,
        hjust = 1,
        lineheight = y_label_lineheight
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = x_label_size),

      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),

     legend.position = "right",
     legend.box = "vertical",
     legend.direction = "vertical",
     legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size),
     legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),

     plot.margin = margin(6, 6, 6, 6)
)

if (show_p_as == "raw") {
  p <- p +
    viridis::scale_colour_viridis(
      option = colour_scheme,
      direction = -colour_direction,
      trans = "reverse",
      name = colour_label,
      guide = guide_colourbar(
        order = 1,
        direction = "vertical",
        title.position = "top",
        label.position = "right",
        barheight = unit(35, "mm"),
        barwidth = unit(4, "mm")
      )
    )
} else {
  p <- p +
    viridis::scale_colour_viridis(
      option = colour_scheme,
      direction = colour_direction,
      name = colour_label,
      guide = guide_colourbar(
        order = 1,
        direction = "vertical",
        title.position = "top",
        label.position = "right",
        barheight = unit(35, "mm"),
        barwidth = unit(4, "mm")
      )
    )
}

  if (!is.null(cluster_col)) {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(
        vars(.data[[cluster_col]]),
        scales = "free_y"
      )
  }

  fixed_plot <- set_fixed_panel_size(
    p,
    panel_width = panel_width_cm,
    panel_height = panel_height_cm,
    left_axis_width = left_axis_width_cm,
    unit = "cm"
  )

  if (save_plot) {
    ggsave(
      filename = filename,
      plot = fixed_plot,
      width = device_width,
      height = device_height,
      units = "in",
      limitsize = FALSE
    )
  }

  return(fixed_plot)
}

```

```{r Visualise enrichment results}

enrich_df <- enrich_results@result

p_fixed <- plot_enrich_dotplot_fixed_panel(
  enrich_df,
  top_n = 20,
  p_col = "p.adjust",
  show_p_as = "raw",
  label_mode = "wrap",
  label_width = 30,

  # actual grid size
  panel_width_cm = 6,
  panel_height_cm = 10,

  # saved file size
  save_plot = TRUE,
  filename = "GSEA_CM_XYZ.png",
  device_width = 10,
  device_height = 8,
  left_axis_width_cm = 1,
  colour_scheme = "viridis",
  title = "GSEA_CM_XYZ",
  order_by = "p",
  y_label_size = 7,
  y_label_lineheight = 0.8,

) 


grid::grid.newpage()

grid::grid.draw(p_fixed)
```

#Transform CM Seurat object into the Cell Data Set object

cds <- cluster_cells(cds)

cds <- learn_graph(cds)
